links.outcome: Similarity of non-edited auto-segmentation versus manually corrected contours, plus dosimetric impact
links.effect: Skilled manual editing was needed for a few OARs; mean ΔDmean rose up to 837.14 cGyRBE for oesophagus and larynx. DLS failed in 11 patients; correction took 6.24 min.
links.quote: The model's overall performance is adequate and efficient with skilled manual editing needed for few OARs.

links.outcome: Auto-segmentation accuracy in a real-world HNC cohort with anatomical challenges, artifacts, and implants
links.effect: DLS failed in 11 patients with significant anatomical challenges and artifact. DSC was poor (<0.5) in 8 OARs and HD very poor (>8mm) in 14 OARs versus manual contours.
links.quote: DLS failed in 11 patients with significant anatomical challenges and artifact.
